title: A small effect at large scale
hook: Two stated cases: explore the population needed to turn a small rate into a count.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the population needed to turn a small rate into a count affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Added, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the population needed to turn a small rate into a count in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy program has 6.8e+07 eligible units, uptake fraction 0.005, and added amount 1 per participant. What total is added?
